basics.name: Dave Beach
basics.heroText2: A freelance developer that gets shit done
basics.summary: I’m a senior full-stack developer with 17 years of experience building everything from satellite imaging platforms to digital ecosystems for global brands. My strength lies in combining technical precision with big-picture thinking to help mission-driven teams and businesses bring meaningful ideas to life. I believe the best work happens when there’s alignment between values and craft. I’m drawn to projects that make a difference. Whether you need a creative collaborator to help launch a fast, resilient web app, or someone who can lead a dev team through complex challenges with clarity and care, I bring the technical precision of a lead engineer and the mindset of a grounded idealist with a bias for action.
